# 📝 Pending Features for Faulty Dashboard

This document tracks features that are planned, in-progress, or completed.
The goal is to provide visibility into what’s next for the error monitoring system.

---

## 🛡️ Core Features (MVP)

- ✅ Error capture with fingerprinting
- ✅ Event creation with context + code snippet
- ✅ Dashboard table: list errors with class, message, event, latest event
- ✅ Error detail page: full message, backtrace, code snippet, context, events list
- ✅ Pagination for error list
- ✅ Ability to mark errors as **Resolved** / **Unresolved**
- ✅ Restrict dashboard access to specific users
- ✅ Ability to assign an error to a user
- ✅ Added Manual error capturing
- ✅ Add filters in index page:
    ✅ By status (Resolved / Unresolved)
    ✅ By Assignee
    ✅ By timeframe (7 days, 30 days)
- ✅ Add Comments Section
